stemMd: How many moles are present in 8.8 g of CO₂? Use molar mass 44 g mol⁻¹.
explanationMd: Amount of substance equals mass divided by molar mass: 8.8/44 = 0.20 mol. A check is to multiply 0.20 mol by 44 g mol⁻¹, recovering 8.8 g. Unit cancellation also shows why division is required.

distractorRationale.b: This places the decimal point one place too high.
distractorRationale.d: This places the decimal point one place too low.
distractorRationale.a: This multiplies mass by molar mass instead of dividing.
